TOOLING BURST FL-2b — fire lane: contact envelope = head only + forward-only contacts; byte locks; streak tail field (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor R-C5-95, defects F-C5-30, F-C5-28). task_id "FL-2b".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4p, FL-1a, FL-1b, FL-2 and the new row "FL-2b — head-only contact envelope · forward-only contacts · byte locks · streak tail field" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (the G1 sweep after FL-2: the painted convex envelope, fraction/along ordering, release_sweep_start; the streak distance-field build; the halo/embers of FL-2), export/effect_kit.py (travel_primitives / distance fields), runs/C-5/cliffside_v35/ (staged real scene, READ ONLY — fix the exporter, never the staged copy), runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd (env KIT_CYCLES, FACE = comma-separated move actions; prints PROBE_EVENTS= JSON with each effect's events + contacted names), runs/C-5/t3/FL1-fire-8dir-v35/events_kit9.txt, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_props_layer.py, fixtures/ (read; re-baseline only per Part B).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — FIRST (F-C5-30, real scene v35, conductor-measured with probe_events): casting fire_bolt_e1_B WEST (FACE=move_left), NORTH-WEST and SOUTH-EAST from (3760,640) logs `contact age 1 body_index 3` — VfxTarget_44, the shield dummy that stands EAST of the caster, BEHIND the cast — and the full impact burst plays on top of the caster; NORTH is clean (nothing behind). Cause: FL-2 made the collision envelope the convex hull of the painted head AND streak; the streak's 2.0-BH tail trails back past the caster into the shield's footprint. Fix: (A1) the collision envelope is the HEAD ONLY (alpha >= 32 of the head sprite; the streak is a trail, never a collider); (A2) a contact candidate is valid only if (body.global_position − release_socket)·facing > 0 (ahead of the release) — behind-the-caster bodies are never struck; (A3) keep FL-1b/FL-2's emergence sweep for the head so the shield is still struck first when cast EAST. Trace clauses (probe_events on a re-export of the v35 inputs into runs/C-5/t3/FL-2b/reexport/): E → contact body 3 age ≤ 6; W, NW, SE → NO contact, expire by range fizzle (age ≥ 18); N unchanged; ice E → contact body 3 with the crown under it.

PART B — BYTE LOCKS re-opened by FL-2's emitted-scene change (outside suite): IceTreatmentImportTests.test_ten_existing_export_bytes_unchanged, PieceLap2ExportTests.test_six_kits_and_v1_match_488_file_pre_t4j_hash_table, ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_original_eight_export_byte_lock — re-baseline each ONLY with a per-lock diff summary attributing every changed entry to FL-2/FL-2b (halo, cast layers, embers, sweep code, envelope) — same rule as FL-1b; any other difference = regression, report it. BoltChainEmissionTests.test_current_catalogue_and_original_kits_unchanged stays red (T4x kits; E3-r1) — name it.

PART C — F-C5-28: ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_tail_field_runs_from_tail_to_socket_and_grey_keeps_bands reads 255 at the streak's tail end (expected 0) since FL-2's streak `erode_noise .3`. Diagnose: did the distance field's direction flip (tail must erode FIRST, i.e. field 0 at the tail rising to 255 at the socket) or did the test read a different plane? If the field flipped, fix the bake (both fire arms; kit.json + the streak field PNG only) and prove with the field's row profile; if the test is stale, realign it with the evidence. NEVER weaken the assertion.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-2b/acceptance.json): Part A five-direction probe outputs (before/after); Part B per-lock diff summaries; Part C field profile + diagnosis; 14 kits byte-identical (fire arms: kit.json + streak field only if Part C fixes the bake); full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the Part A clauses (five directions), the tail-field clause; extend/realign only the named tests. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except the two fire arms (named files), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-2b/; fixtures/ only for Part B re-baselines (list each). Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-2b"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
